about: Expected port-suite failures on the one compiler. Each entry names the failing tests, why they fail, and the plan task that owns them (docs/migration/index.md). The port runner (scripts/ports.mjs) diffs failing-test sets against this ledger: a failure not listed here is a regression, and a listed failure that passes must be removed. Test names are exactly as the runner parses them; names in parentheses are the runner's pseudo-failures (docs/testing.md). Recorded from the pre-M1 fleet run of 2026-09-23 (binary ~/lilscript-work/bin/pre-m1/lilscript, 26 ports, 21 fully green) and re-checked with scripts/ports.mjs on 2026-09-24: the node:test spec reporter reports a failing test and its failing parent suite as two names; monacolil's check:site passes, so its entry was removed; On 2026-09-24, after the M2.8/M2.9 release committed each goal port's rewrite to its repository, mdast-util-from-markdownlil, remark-parselil and react-markdownlil ran green with `--patches none` (binary release-m1) and their entries were removed.

tests: User provided debug names are always respected
entries.reason: Upstream tests require ../../dist/mobx.cjs.production.min.js relative to tests/upstream/base, a path the port's layout does not have (its dist is at the repository root). Independent of the compiler.
entries.owner: M2.8 (fix the port's upstream-test path mapping when its rewrite is committed)
